sentences.text: Arctic Harbour Capital Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-24 under the industry code 70200, management consultancy activities.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-09-30.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has harbour and capital words but the registered industry is consultancy and the record shows no ocean use.
